en.headline: The Gruffalo returns to the Academy this weekend
en.dek: Tall Stories’ hour-long English musical of the Julia Donaldson picture book plays the Rita Tong Liu Drama Theatre from Friday, with a second run the following weekend.
body: The children’s musical The Gruffalo opens at the Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts on Friday, 4 September, in a run that also covers 5 to 6 September and 11 to 13 September at the Rita Tong Liu Drama Theatre in Wan Chai.

The Academy listing says the production is presented by ABA Productions with Tall Stories of the United Kingdom and CDP Kids Productions of Australia. It is an English-language stage version of the picture book by Julia Donaldson and Axel Scheffler, following Mouse through the deep, dark wood. The running time is about 60 minutes with no interval. The presenters describe the show as suitable for children aged three and above; every audience member needs a ticket.

Tickets are sold through Cityline, with listed prices from HK$275 for a restricted-view seat to HK$475. The Academy and Cityline pages list afternoon performances on the Friday-to-Sunday dates and an additional evening performance on 4 September. ABA Productions first brought the show to Hong Kong in 2009 and is staging this return in the production’s 25th year.

zh.headline: 繪本音樂劇《咕嚎牛》本周末起在演藝學院上演
zh.dek: 英國Tall Stories改編自朱莉婕・唐納森繪本的英語音樂劇，周五起在灣仔演藝學院麗瑞楠戲劇院演出，每場約60分鐘。
body: 兒童音樂劇《咕嚎牛》（The Gruffalo）將於9月4日（星期五）起在香港演藝學院麗瑞楠戲劇院上演，檔期為4至6日及11至13日。
演藝學院節目頁列明，製作由ABA Productions聯同英國Tall Stories及澳洲CDP Kids Productions呈獻，以英語演出，改編自朱莉婕・唐納森與阿克塞爾・舍夫勒的繪本，講述小老鼠走進深林的故事。演出長約60分鐘，沒有中場休息。主辦單位指節目適合三歲或以上小童，所有入場者均須持票。
門票經城市售票網發售，票價由限制視線座位275港元至475港元。學院及售票網列出周五至日下午場，以及9月4日加場晚場。ABA Productions 2009年首次把該劇帶到香港，今次重演適逢製作登上舞台25年。
